criteria.detail: Every persisted payload and referenced file is checksummed.
AST check of direct agent-class calls.
Actual train/validation evidence audited before any training.
Exact supporting quotes resolve to checksummed snapshots; recommendations remain hypotheses.
Curated excerpts alone do not demonstrate web retrieval.
Test metrics are excluded from search and configuration selection.
Conventional baseline uses the same seed and selected splits; negative deltas are retained.
At least three completed seeds, with a shared validation-selected configuration.
Validation-calibrated abstention with a persistent benchmark review queue.
Every promoted stage has an independent reviewer report.
Decision source and stage are recorded; exact prompts/schema/results are retained.
Requires passing tests and measured fault injection for this exact source tree.
A transcript alone is not proof that retraining reproduces predictions and metrics.
Every unresolved reviewer issue requires an explicit approved mitigation.
Requires named independent demonstrator/reviewer, bound predictions and checksummed environment evidence.

unresolved_reviewer_issues: All three prior-art literature sources are curated_excerpt with retrieval_mode=cache; evidence base is limited to pre-curated single-sentence excerpts and does not constitute live retrieval evidence

All three prior-art sources are curated_excerpt with retrieval_mode=cache; the cited quotes establish traceability but do not independently support the specific hyperparameters (stride 4, 4 heads, head_dim 16, FFN hidden 128, 2 layers) in the compact_conv_stem_transformer proposal; these are design extrapolations beyond the cited text
At σ=0.4 the test AUROC is 0.0018 (max_softmax) and 0.0016 (predictive_entropy), indicating near-complete inversion of the OOD ranking—samples the model is most confident about are the most corrupted

Cited prior-art quotes establish traceability but do not independently support the specific architectural hyperparameters (stride 4, 4 heads, head_dim 16, FFN hidden 128, 2 layers) in the compact_conv_stem_transformer proposal; these are design choices extrapolated beyond the cited text
Class 7 (cancer-associated stroma) recall is 56.5% (F1=0.70), the weakest class; 110 of 421 samples misclassified, primarily to smooth muscle (63) and debris (47)

Deterministic warning: all three literature sources are curated_excerpt origin with retrieval_mode=cache; this is not live retrieval evidence and the evidence base is limited to pre-curated single-sentence excerpts.
Deterministic: OOD AUROC (0.3938) is below random chance (0.5); max_softmax confidence is anti-correlated with OOD-ness at σ≥0.25, making the abstention threshold counterproductive for OOD samples

Evidence quotes are short excerpts that establish traceability but do not independently support the specific architectural hyperparameters (stride 4, 4 heads, head_dim 16, FFN hidden 128, 2 layers) in the compact_conv_stem_transformer proposal; these are design choices extrapolated beyond the cited text.

The abstention mechanism provides no OOD protection as configured; OOD samples at higher corruption levels are more likely to be auto-accepted (covered) than abstained, undermining the safety purpose of selective prediction
